title: Skill Finder
description: Prompts that were typed again and again in almost the same way. A task that keeps repeating is worth turning into a skill or shared instructions for the agent.
summary: Looked at {analyzed} prompts: {clustered} prompts fall into {clusters} clusters repeated 3 times or more.
heuristicNote: Clusters are grouped by keywords, so they are approximate: a cluster can be missing or mixed.
truncated: There are more than 20,000 prompts in this range, so only the newest ones were looked at. Narrow the time range to see them all.
emptyTitle: No prompt has been repeated 3 times yet

ai.privateNote: Uses your own API key. AI results are visible only to you.
ai.addKey: Add an AI API key to assess clusters and draft SKILL.md
ai.skillHint: Review and edit before use. Put the file in your agent's skills folder, e.g. .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md.

errors.llm_key_invalid: The AI provider rejected the API key.
errors.llm_model_not_found: The selected model does not exist.
errors.llm_quota_exceeded: Quota exhausted or rate limited at the AI provider. Try again later.
errors.llm_timeout: The AI took too long to respond (over 60 seconds). Try again later.
errors.llm_provider_error: Could not reach the AI provider. Try again later.
errors.llm_bad_output: The AI returned a badly formatted result. Retry or pick a stronger model.
errors.cluster_not_found: The cluster is no longer in this time range. Reload the page.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to use AI on this cluster.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong running AI. Try again later.
errors.no_clusters: No task was repeated at least 3 times in this range, so there is nothing to match yet. Try a wider range.
errors.catalog_unavailable: Could not read the skill catalog (no source is enabled, or GitHub is unreachable). Try again later or ask a leader to check the sources.

catalog.title: Suggest ready-made skills
catalog.description: Match your repeated tasks against existing community skills (for example anthropics/skills) so you can use one instead of writing your own.
catalog.privateNote: Uses your own API key. The cluster labels and the skill names and descriptions from the catalog are sent to the AI provider. Results are visible only to you.
catalog.addKey: Add an AI API key to get ready-made skill suggestions
catalog.nothingFits: Out of {count} skills considered, none clearly fits your repeated tasks.
catalog.picksNote: Considered {count} skills from the catalog. Read the SKILL.md carefully before installing: it is third-party code.
catalog.sourcesHint: The GitHub repos the suggestions read from. Only a leader can add or remove them.
catalog.sourcesHintLeader: The public GitHub repos the suggestions read from (shared by the whole team). The server reads the default branch and caches it for about 6 hours.
catalog.noSources: No sources yet. A leader should add a GitHub repo.
catalog.sourceError: Could not update this source. Try again.

errors.invalid_url: Only public GitHub repo URLs such as https://github.com/owner/repo are accepted.
errors.unknown: Could not add the source. Try again later.
